title: ci: a diff confined to a package ui tests import (packages/lint, spec, client, core, formula, sdui-parser, types) skips the Test UI shards on the PR and in the queue
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibz8HEj53Wx2uphTo2o

Filing gate: ① a named, reproduced defect (a CI gap that let a red reach `main`). Root-cause card for the p0 anchor #28219.

## Business reason

**Who:** every lane, through the merge queue. **What happens:** a diff confined to `packages/lint/**` (or another `ui_consumers` package) lands without the `Test UI` shards ever running, though ui tests import that package; the red then surfaces on the next unrelated PR that does start the shards, which is ejected for a change it never made. **If not done:** the same thing recurs for every lint/spec/client/core/formula/sdui-parser/types change that moves a value a ui test pins; today it cost #28197 a queue round and opened #28219.

## Mechanism

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the `changes` filters (≈L522–570): `ui` (which starts `Lint UI` and the `Test UI (n/16)` shards) lists `ui/**` and shared roots; `ui_consumers` lists `packages/spec/**`, `client`, `core`, `formula`, `lint`, `sdui-parser`, `types`, and starts `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` only.
- #28192 (`3efccfd5`, `packages/lint/**` + `packages/metadata-protocol/**`): its queue CI run [41091107812](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/41091107812) shows `Test UI (${{ matrix.shard }}/16)` and `Lint UI` **skipped**, `Type Check UI` / `Build & E2E UI` / `Live E2E UI` success. Merged 16:55:58Z.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.problemsAgree-27799.test.tsx` imports `validateStackExpressions` from `@objectstack/lint`; the next queue build that ran the shards (41095303977, #28197) failed it.

## Fix direction (owner decides the shape)

Start the `Test UI` shards when `ui_consumers` matches, or narrow it by measurement (which `ui_consumers` packages ui test files import) and add those to the condition that starts the shards. Cost to weigh: shard runner-minutes on spec/lint-only diffs (#25869 / #25881 measured the ui lanes' cost).

## Acceptance

- [ ] A diff confined to `packages/lint/**` starts the `Test UI` shards on the PR and in the queue (filter self-test or a measured run).
- [ ] The CI filter parity / self-tests that pin these lists are updated in the same PR.

## Reader and dedupe

- **Who acts:** `domain:devx` (CI filters; #25867 / #25881 / #28089 were this lane's).
- **Dedupe:** #28089 (package.json in ui/docs filters, ui test inputs in `core:`) and #25867 (queue ui lanes from the diff) are related, closed, and do not cover `ui_consumers` → Test UI. Open issues since 16:50Z: none.

Refs #28219 · Refs #28192 · Refs #28089 · Refs #25867
